app.prototypeBanner: Prototype. The guideline content has not been checked against the source documents yet.

hero.title: Check what Indian health guidelines say about your symptoms
hero.paragraph: AIRA matches the symptoms you describe against a written rule table and shows how urgent they are. Each answer lists the guideline document and page it comes from. AIRA does not diagnose illness and does not give medicine doses.
hero.emergencyNotice: If this is an emergency, call 112 now.

whatYouGet.heading: What you get
whatYouGet.urgencyText: Emergency, see a doctor soon, or can usually be managed at home.
whatYouGet.guidelinesText: A short summary written only from guideline passages, with the document and page.
whatYouGet.signsText: The warning signs the guidelines list for your condition.

whoFor.heading: Who it is for
whoFor.text: Adults in India with everyday symptoms and the people who look after them, and community health workers who want to look up a protocol quickly.

coverage.heading: Conditions covered
coverage.fallbackText: The full list is on the Sources page.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.step1: Fixed rules check your message first. Emergency signs, thoughts of self-harm, requests for a diagnosis or a dose, and messages about children are handled by written rules before any AI is used. For an emergency, AIRA shows a fixed message and helplines and writes nothing else.
howItWorks.step2: A rule table sets the urgency. The level comes from a table that cites its guideline source. The AI cannot change it.
howItWorks.step3: A short summary is written from guideline passages only. Every statement points to a source. If the text cannot be checked against the passages, AIRA shows the passages themselves.

limits.heading: What AIRA does not do
limits.item2: It does not give medicine doses or advice on mixing medicines.
limits.item3: It is for adults only (messages about babies and children get a notice to see a doctor).
limits.item5: It covers only the listed conditions.
limits.item6: It is not a replacement for a doctor or emergency services.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.statement1: AIRA does not store your messages. There is no account and no database of messages.
privacy.statement2: Messages that match an emergency, self-harm, refusal or child rule are handled on the AIRA server and are not sent to Google.
privacy.statement3Prefix: Other messages are sent to Google's Gemini API: first to turn the message into a search vector and, when the model is enabled, to write the summary.
privacy.statement3Suffix: Google handles those messages under its terms.
privacy.statement4: AIRA server logs do not contain message text.
privacy.statement5: The site sets no cookies and uses no analytics or advertising trackers. It stores only your chosen language in your browser and nothing else.
privacy.statement6: The hosting provider, Render, may record technical request data such as IP addresses in its own logs.
privacy.statement7: The printed summary is created in your browser and is not sent anywhere.

terms.heading: Terms of use
terms.statement1: AIRA gives general information from published guidelines. It is not medical advice, not a diagnosis, and not a substitute for a doctor.
terms.statement2: In an emergency, call 112 or go to the nearest hospital. Do not wait for AIRA.
terms.statement3: AIRA is a prototype. Its clinical content has not been reviewed by a doctor unless the review status above says so.
terms.statement4: Guideline documents belong to their publishers. AIRA links to them on the Sources page.
terms.statement5: The service may be slow, unavailable or change without notice. Free hosting can pause it when it is idle, and the first request after a pause can take about a minute.
terms.statement6: You decide what to do with the information. The people who built AIRA are not responsible for decisions made using it, to the extent the law allows.

crisisBanner.heading: Support Is Available
crisisBanner.defaultMessage: If you or someone you know is in distress or needs mental health support, trained counselors are available 24/7.

refusalNotice.heading: Outside Guideline Scope
refusalNotice.defaultMessage: AIRA does not provide medical diagnoses, medication dosages, or prescription drug advice.
refusalNotice.action: A doctor or pharmacist can answer this.

outOfScope.heading: Adult Guidelines Only
outOfScope.defaultMessage: AIRA covers adult primary care guidelines only. For infants, children, or specialized conditions, please consult a pediatrician or doctor immediately.

sourcesPage.intro: AIRA draws exclusively from published clinical guidelines issued by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) and the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MOHFW), Government of India.
